title: Five months. Molecules all change. I am other I now.
html_source:
Paraphrased: “I change ‘cos my matter has changed.” The Stephen who got a quid off AE for a prostitute has materially changed since then.

Two opposing philosophies emerge in Stephen’s thoughts– your matter changes but your underlying potential is constant.

Stephen’s unassertive intellect can’t decide on either. His own indecision steers a path between two opposing philosophies.

Compare Stephen’s remarks about what ghosts are. Figuratively speaking, the old Stephen has become a ghost.
